name: Binance
description: Finance and Fintech: cryptocurrency exchange with public APIs for market data, spot/derivatives trading, wallets and account management.
access_notes: API keys are created self-serve on the API Management page of a Binance account (account signup requires identity/KYC verification in most regions). SIGNED endpoints additionally require request signing with HMAC-SHA256, RSA or Ed25519 keys. A public spot testnet also exists for testing.
mcp_notes: No official Binance vendor MCP server found in Binance docs; multiple community MCP servers exist (e.g. binance-mcp-server on PyPI, several GitHub repos). No Binance toolkit found in the Composio toolkits index; Composio's CryptoKit blog mentions Binance but the toolkit list does not include it.
uncertainty_notes: Core spot API delivers account/market events via WebSocket user data streams rather than HTTP webhooks, hence supports_webhooks=false for the main API (some side products like Binance Pay have merchant notifications). Vendor-MCP absence based on searches 'Binance official MCP server' which surfaced only community servers.

evidence.note: Official spot REST docs: API keys created on the account's API Management page; SIGNED endpoints require HMAC-SHA-256 (or RSA/Ed25519) signatures over request params.
Official developer portal WebSocket API request-security page documenting API key + HMAC/RSA/Ed25519 signing; confirms websocket protocol and self-serve key creation.
Community (not vendor) MCP server for the Binance API; representative of the community MCP ecosystem found in searches.
Official Binance Academy page: 'You can obtain your API secret key by creating an API key on Binance' — self-serve key creation for account holders.
